import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open('../first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(float)
R,G,B = im[...,0], im[...,1], im[...,2]
# broader ball mask: yellowish felt
mask = (G>100)&(R>80)&(B<120)&(G>B+30)&(R>B+30)
ys,xs = np.where(mask)
# fit circle via least squares on boundary-ish points: use all mask points, algebraic fit
x = xs.astype(float); y = ys.astype(float)
A = np.c_[2*x, 2*y, np.ones_like(x)]
b = x**2 + y**2
sol, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, b, rcond=None)
cx, cy = sol[0], sol[1]
r = np.sqrt(sol[2] + cx**2 + cy**2)
print(\"circle fit: cx=%.3f cy=%.3f r=%.3f  n=%d\" % (cx,cy,r,len(x)))
# residual distribution
d = np.sqrt((x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2)
print(\"radius percentiles:\", np.percentile(d,[1,5,50,95,99]))
# check mask pixels near boundary
print(\"max d\", d.max())
# Felt shading analysis inside circle, exclude markings
yy,xx = np.mgrid[0:144,0:256]
dd = np.sqrt((xx-cx)**2+(yy-cy)**2)
inside = dd <= r-1
lum = 0.299*R+0.587*G+0.114*B
# felt = inside, not dark marking, not white seam (seam: B high / pale)
dark = (R<95)&(G<100)
seam = (B>90)&(R>150)&(G>150)
felt = inside & ~dark & ~seam
print(\"felt count\", felt.sum())
Xn=(xx-cx)/r; Yn=-(yy-cy)/r; Zn=np.sqrt(np.clip(1-Xn**2-Yn**2,0,1))
# fit lum = a + b*Zn + c*Xn + d*Yn (light dir + vertical AO)
M = np.c_[np.ones(felt.sum()), Zn[felt], Xn[felt], Yn[felt]]
coef, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(M, lum[felt], rcond=None)
print(\"lum fit a,b,c,d:\", coef)
pred = M@coef
res = lum[felt]-pred
print(\"residual std %.2f, range %.1f..%.1f\" % (res.std(), res.min(), res.max()))
# channel ratios on felt
for ch,name in [(R,'R'),(G,'G'),(B,'B')]:
    print(name, \"mean %.1f std %.1f\" % (ch[felt].mean(), ch[felt].std()))
# seam pixel stats
print(\"seam count\", seam.sum(), \"color mean\", im[seam].mean(axis=0) if seam.sum() else None)
print(\"dark marking count\", (inside&dark).sum(), \"color\", im[inside&dark].mean(axis=0))
# noise spatial: residual correlation on felt at 1px
EOF"
